title: RBGA: Residual-Budget Guide Arbitration for Offline-to-Online Safe Reinforcement Learning in Dexterous Manipulation
abstract: arXiv:2610.33494v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Dexterous manipulation requires robots to leverage existing datasets for rapid skill acquisition while maintaining safety during real-world deployment to prevent damage to the robot or its surroundings. Offline-to-online safe reinforcement learning (O2O safe RL) provides a promising solution for this problem by leveraging prior experience for online improvement under safety constraints, thereby mitigating the sample inefficiency and exploration risk of learning safe policies from scratch. However, existing O2O safe RL approaches do not explicitly account for the safety budget already consumed when making decisions within an episode. translated_title: RBGA：面向灵巧操作的离线到在线安全强化学习的剩余预算引导仲裁
translated_abstract: 灵巧操作要求机器人能够利用已有数据集快速习得技能，同时在真实世界部署过程中保持安全性，以避免对机器人自身或周围环境造成损害。离线到在线安全强化学习（O2O safe RL）为这一问题提供了一种有前景的解决方案，它在安全约束下利用先验经验进行在线改进，从而缓解了从头学习安全策略时的样本效率低下和探索风险问题。然而，现有的 O2O 安全强化学习方法在单回合（episode）内做决策时，并未显式考虑已经消耗的安全预算。因此，早期产生过多的代价会使得后续的探索和策略改进几乎没有余地。为了解决这一局限性，我们提出了剩余预算引导仲裁算法（RBGA），该算法显式地跟踪回合内剩余的安全预算，并利用……
tldr: 提出RBGA算法，通过显式跟踪回合内剩余安全预算并据此进行决策仲裁，解决了现有离线到在线安全强化学习方法因早期过度消耗安全预算而限制后续探索与策略改进的问题，提升灵巧操作的安全性与效率。
en_tdlr: RBGA explicitly tracks the remaining per-episode safety budget and uses it to arbitrate decisions in offline-to-online safe reinforcement learning, addressing the limitation that existing methods ignore already-consumed budget and thus enable safer and more effective dexterous manipulation.
